summary: Attended middle-gear chain runner: auto-answers mechanical gates, surfaces decision/risk/shortcut/archiving gates inline, and yields with protocol-1.1 handoff predicates at plan and implement-all boundaries.

entry_points.summary: Unknown/untagged gates resolve to ask; mechanical auto-proceed requires explicit category metadata.
Resume refuses handoff.json without protocol-1.1 attend_resume predicate.
Expected head mismatch emits attend_resume_halt and hard-halts unless user accepts new base.
Run-scoped state file is $BASE/archive/$RUN_ID/attend-state.json, never overnight-state.json.
Runs lint-halt-categories --check-chain before first step; advisory only, chain still proceeds.
Reviewer blocker or audit reject emits attend_risk_halt; asks fix-retry/abort/continue-anyway.
Emits preset steps as name:yield_after lines; sole authority for chain composition.
Only plan and implement-all boundaries yield by declaration.
C14 archive set-difference identifying a step's sub-run, excluding *-overnight-*.
Canonical category enum: decision, risk, shortcut, archiving, mechanical_proceed.
Prints registered category or ask for unknown/untagged question IDs.
When Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=1, validates five env vars are non-empty and embeds attend_resume.
Optional protocol-1.1 resume predicate consumed by /z-attend resume.

invariants: Unknown or untagged gate category resolves to ask, never mechanical_proceed.
Only explicitly mechanical gates are auto-answered.
Boundary yield currently declared for plan and implement-all only.
Protocol-1.1 attend handoff requires all five attend_resume fields non-empty.
HEAD and phase/cursor mismatches are hard resume halts (R1/R2).
State writes go through chain-runner locking/atomic write path.
A step-outcome risk signal (reviewer blocker or audit reject) never silently advances the chain (Step 2.7).
gotchas: No Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt in attend mode; gates surface inline, unlike /z-overnight.
Resume validates handoff.json's attend_resume predicate, not SESSION.md.
State file is attend-state.json, not overnight-state.json.
Preflight lint (--check-chain) is advisory, not blocking.
surface-shortcut.sh exit 1 is the intentional surface-ask signal; 0 is no-op; 2 is infra fallback-to-ask.
quick-build preset has no review-all step (2 steps only: plan, implement-all).
research-build preset includes a test step (research, plan, test, implement-all, review-all).
